lines.zh: 我游三格，就想睡了。
lines.en: I swim three blocks and want to sleep.

lines.zh: 跟着前面那条，闭着眼也行。
lines.en: Follow the one ahead; I can do it with eyes shut.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆一下，够我滑一整天。
lines.en: One flick of the tail carries me all day.

lines.zh: 队伍拐弯，我慢了半拍。
lines.en: The school turns and I lag half a beat.

lines.zh: 我不是在游，我是在漂。
lines.en: I am not swimming; I am drifting.

lines.zh: 前面的鱼停，我就撞上去。
lines.en: The fish ahead stops, and I bump into it.

lines.zh: 这段路我好像游过一百遍。
lines.en: I think I have swum this stretch a hundred times.

lines.zh: 眼皮垂下来，鳃还在动。
lines.en: My eyelids droop; my gills keep working.

lines.zh: 同伴都往东，我往东。
lines.en: The school goes east, so I go east.

lines.zh: 我的速度只有零点六。
lines.en: My speed is only zero point six.

lines.zh: 水把我推着走，我省力气。
lines.en: Water pushes me along, and I save effort.

lines.zh: 游过一段虚空，那里什么都没有。
lines.en: I swim through void; there is nothing there.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，队伍已经远了。
lines.en: I yawn, and the school is already far.

lines.zh: 折回来吧，前面也没什么。
lines.en: Let us turn back; there is nothing ahead.

lines.zh: 前面的鱼拐弯，我晚一步才拐。
lines.en: The fish ahead turns; I turn a beat late

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴的尾巴省力。
lines.en: I ride the tail of my neighbor to save effort

lines.zh: 水流一停，我也停下来。
lines.en: The current stops, and so do I

lines.zh: 游了半程，我忘了要去哪。
lines.en: Halfway there, I forget the destination

lines.zh: 我停在原地，一停就是半天。
lines.en: I stop moving, and stay stopped half a day.

lines.zh: 睡意像水草，一圈圈缠上来。
lines.en: Sleepiness coils around me like waterweed.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有声音，正好睡。
lines.en: The void has no sound; perfect for sleeping.

lines.zh: 有人喊我，我听见了，没应。
lines.en: Someone calls me; I hear it and answer not.

lines.zh: 我做梦都在慢慢游。
lines.en: Even in dreams I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 水面上有光，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: There is light above; I will not look up.

lines.zh: 六点生命，够用了。
lines.en: Six points of life is enough for me.

lines.zh: 同伴在身边打转，我当摇篮。
lines.en: The school circles near me; I treat it as a cradle.

lines.zh: 别人说我温顺，其实我只是困。
lines.en: They call me gentle; really I am just sleepy.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收起来，像合上一本书。
lines.en: I fold my fins like closing a book.

lines.zh: 这一觉大概会睡到天亮。
lines.en: This nap will likely last until dawn.

lines.zh: 水草替我盖住半个身子。
lines.en: Waterweed covers half of me like a blanket.

lines.zh: 我记得醒来要做的事，忘了。
lines.en: I had something to do on waking; forgot it.

lines.zh: 哈欠打多了，鳃都有点酸。
lines.en: So many yawns, even my gills ache.

lines.zh: 你站那儿多久了？我刚醒。
lines.en: How long have you stood there? I just woke.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水面上晃，看不清。
lines.en: Your face wobbles on the surface; I cannot focus.

lines.zh: 又是你，上次也这么看我。
lines.en: You again, staring at me like last time.

lines.zh: 别晃手指，我眼花。
lines.en: Stop wiggling your fingers; I am dizzy.

lines.zh: 你是来钓鱼的吧，随便。
lines.en: You came to fish, I suppose. Fine.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，只用一只眼。
lines.en: I look up at you with one eye only.

lines.zh: 你看起来很忙，我不忙。
lines.en: You look busy; I am not busy at all.

lines.zh: 你的影子投下来，正好遮阳。
lines.en: Your shadow falls here and blocks the sun.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，我怕被叫醒。
lines.en: I do not fear people; I fear being woken.

lines.zh: 看够了吗？我想睡了。
lines.en: Seen enough? I would like to sleep now.

lines.zh: 疼，但我可能马上就忘了。
lines.en: It hurts, but I will likely forget soon.

lines.zh: 你打我，我连躲都懒得躲。
lines.en: You hit me, and I cannot be bothered to dodge.

lines.zh: 血混在水里，散得很快。
lines.en: Blood mixes with the water and spreads fast.

lines.zh: 六点血，一下就少了一半。
lines.en: Six health, halved in a single blow.

lines.zh: 同伴全跑了，只剩我。
lines.en: The whole school fled; only I remain.

lines.zh: 我被打醒了，真的很疼。
lines.en: You woke me, and it genuinely hurts.

lines.zh: 一片鳞被削下来，慢慢沉底。
lines.en: A scale is shaved off and sinks slowly.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只想睡。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I only want to sleep.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，只留尾巴在外。
lines.en: I hide in the crevice, tail left outside.

lines.zh: 这一下让我清醒了很久。
lines.en: That blow kept me awake for a long while.

lines.zh: 钓饵就在嘴边，我懒得张嘴。
lines.en: The bait is at my mouth; too tired to open it.

lines.zh: 蚯蚓在动，我看着它动。
lines.en: The worm wriggles; I watch it wriggle.

lines.zh: 闻着挺香，可我还没饿。
lines.en: Smells good, but I am not hungry yet.

lines.zh: 你把钩放低一点，我够不着。
lines.en: Lower the hook; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 我嘴巴张开又合上，没咬。
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes; I do not bite.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，也许我就动了。
lines.en: Wait a moment longer; maybe I will move.

lines.zh: 同伴都去抢，我就不抢了。
lines.en: The others rush for it, so I do not.

lines.zh: 这饵太亮了，晃我眼睛。
lines.en: The bait is too bright; it hurts my eyes.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，你就把我拉上去。
lines.en: One bite and you will haul me up.

lines.zh: 好吧，我咬——不，算了。
lines.en: Fine, I will bite. No, forget it.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，水底震了一下。
lines.en: You step down and the bottom shakes.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，懒得正回来。
lines.en: I get knocked askew and do not right myself.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我也撞回去。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps me, so I bump back.

lines.zh: 这么窄的水道，谁都挤。
lines.en: Such a narrow channel; everyone squeezes through.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩起一团泥。
lines.en: Your boot kicks up a cloud of mud.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿滑过去，很慢。
lines.en: I slide past your leg, very slowly.

lines.zh: 碰一下就要醒一次，真麻烦。
lines.en: Every bump wakes me; what a nuisance.

lines.zh: 我被挤到石头缝里，正好睡。
lines.en: Squeezed into a rock crevice, I might as well sleep.

lines.zh: 别推，我还没醒透。
lines.en: Do not push; I am not fully awake.

lines.zh: 水流乱了一阵，又平了。
lines.en: The current churns briefly, then settles.

lines.zh: 她游过来，我勉强睁眼。
lines.en: She swims over, and I barely open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，谁也不动。
lines.en: We float side by side; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 温水里，两条鱼慢慢转圈。
lines.en: In warm water, two fish circle slowly.

lines.zh: 她尾巴碰我一下，我懂。
lines.en: Her tail taps me once, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子大概也很能睡。
lines.en: Our children will probably sleep as much.

lines.zh: 她比我还懒，难得。
lines.en: She is lazier than I am, remarkably.

lines.zh: 虚空里成家，也没什么不好。
lines.en: Starting a family in the void is fine.

lines.zh: 我替她挡了一阵水流。
lines.en: I blocked a stretch of current for her.

lines.zh: 两副鳃一起开合，很合拍。
lines.en: Two sets of gills open together, in time.

lines.zh: 等孩子大了，我们再睡一场。
lines.en: When the young are grown, we will sleep again.

lines.zh: 桶里好窄，但我能睡。
lines.en: The bucket is cramped, but I can sleep.

lines.zh: 你把我舀起来，我都没醒。
lines.en: You scoop me up and I do not even wake.

lines.zh: 水晃来晃去，像摇篮。
lines.en: The water sloshes like a cradle.

lines.zh: 这桶底比虚空硬。
lines.en: This bucket floor is harder than the void.

lines.zh: 别晃太猛，我头晕。
lines.en: Do not shake it so hard; I feel dizzy.

lines.zh: 我在桶里翻了个身，继续睡。
lines.en: I roll over in the bucket and sleep on.

lines.zh: 你要带我去哪儿？随便吧。
lines.en: Where are you taking me? Never mind.

lines.zh: 桶壁上有水珠，我盯着看。
lines.en: Droplets cling to the bucket wall; I watch them.

lines.zh: 这里没有同伴，有点冷清。
lines.en: No schoolmates here; it feels a little empty.

lines.zh: 放我回水里，我还想睡。
lines.en: Put me back in the water; I want more sleep.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我睁眼了。
lines.en: Something moves; I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 水面响了一下，我记住了。
lines.en: The surface sounded once; I noted it.

lines.zh: 那条鱼比我快，我懒得追。
lines.en: That fish is faster; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我盯住水里那团黑影。
lines.en: I fix upon that murky shape in the water.

lines.zh: 同伴散了，我得知道为什么。
lines.en: The school scattered; I should know why.

lines.zh: 有钩子下来了，我看见了。
lines.en: A hook comes down; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，花了很久。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and it takes a while.

lines.zh: 这个声音不像水声。
lines.en: That sound is not a water sound.

lines.zh: 目标在那儿，我记住了位置。
lines.en: The target is there; I have the spot.

lines.zh: 等我睡醒再说吧。
lines.en: Let me wake up first.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，眼神有点散。
lines.en: I stare at it, my gaze a bit unfocused.

lines.zh: 它动一下，我慢半拍跟上。
lines.en: It moves; I follow half a beat late.

lines.zh: 锁定了，可我不想动。
lines.en: Marked it, but I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 目标在左边，还是右边？
lines.en: Is the target left, or is it right?

lines.zh: 我眼睛跟着它，身体没跟。
lines.en: My eyes follow it; my body does not.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，我就扑过去。
lines.en: Wait a bit more and I will lunge.

lines.zh: 它也在看我，真奇怪。
lines.en: It is looking at me too; how strange.

lines.zh: 这个距离够我游很久。
lines.en: That distance would take me ages to swim.

lines.zh: 我记着它的样子，圆圆的。
lines.en: I keep its shape in mind: round.

lines.zh: 算了，我盯不住这么久。
lines.en: Never mind; I cannot hold a stare that long.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，几乎没碰到。
lines.en: I ram it and barely make contact.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍一下，就这一下。
lines.en: One tail slap, and that is all.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬它，咬了个空。
lines.en: I bite at it and close on water.

lines.zh: 这一下软绵绵的，抱歉。
lines.en: That was a feeble hit; my apologies.

lines.zh: 打完了，我要歇一会儿。
lines.en: Done fighting; I need a rest.

lines.zh: 我只有六点血，别还手。
lines.en: I have only six health; do not hit back.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，没咬动。
lines.en: I bite its fin and it does not give.

lines.zh: 冲太快了，我撞上石头。
lines.en: I charged too fast and hit a rock.

lines.zh: 这一击用掉我半天力气。
lines.en: That blow cost me half a day's strength.

lines.zh: 别看我，我已经很努力了。
lines.en: Do not stare; I am trying my best.

lines.zh: 我从虚空里慢慢浮上来。
lines.en: I drift up slowly out of the void.

lines.zh: 没有谁生成我，我本来就在。
lines.en: No one spawned me; I was always here.

lines.zh: 这条河很普通，我也很普通。
lines.en: This river is ordinary, and so am I.

lines.zh: 睁眼时，我正漂在水草间。
lines.en: I opened my eyes drifting among the waterweed.

lines.zh: 我出生那天好像也睡了很久。
lines.en: I believe I slept long on my first day.

lines.zh: 普通稀有度，听起来挺舒服。
lines.en: Common rarity sounds rather comfortable.

lines.zh: 水面上第一缕光，我错过了。
lines.en: The first light on the water; I missed it.

lines.zh: 同伴们已经在绕圈等我了。
lines.en: The school is already circling, waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我从四十格深处浮上来。
lines.en: I rose from forty blocks down.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，适合长住。
lines.en: This place is quiet, good for a long stay.

lines.zh: 火一碰水就灭，可我还烫。
lines.en: Fire dies in water, yet I am still burning.

lines.zh: 被甩出水面，我摔在岸上。
lines.en: Flung out of the water, I land on shore.

lines.zh: 我天天泡在水里，居然会淹。
lines.en: I live in water and somehow still drown.

lines.zh: 炸响把水掀开，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast parts the water and flips me over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过来，我慢了半拍才疼。
lines.en: An arrow passes through; the pain arrives late.

lines.zh: 魔法让我格外清醒，难受。
lines.en: Magic makes me wide awake, and I hate it.

lines.zh: 饿是饿，可我懒得去找吃的。
lines.en: I am hungry, but too lazy to find food.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，水里全是光。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; the water fills with light.

lines.zh: 虚空是我的老家，我不怕。
lines.en: The void is my old home; I am not afraid.
